chunks: 2669 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
"There is no harm in a man washing khaluq off his garment while he is in ihram."
And if the muhrim is compelled to use a snuff containing musk because of an odor that affects his face and an ailment that befalls him, then there is no harm in his using it as snuff.
For Isma'il ibn Jabir asked Aba 'Abdillah, peace be upon him, about that,
and he said: "Use it as snuff."

key_terms.الْخَلُوقَ: a fragrant substance or perfume applied to clothing or the body
key_terms.اِسْتَعِطْ: use it as snuff; administer it through the nose
key_terms.سَعُوطٍ: snuff or medicine administered through the nose
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Is a muhrim allowed to wash perfume from his clothes or use a medicinal snuff containing musk?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings for a muhrim regarding scented substances. It permits washing khaluq from one's garment and allows medicinal use of a musk-containing snuff when there is need due to odor-related discomfort or illness.
